item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Krish pulling a closed drawer that was at rest and stretching a rubber band between his hands.

Which claims about these forces are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: The pull can start the drawer moving from rest.
options.B: The stretch can change the rubber band's shape.
options.C: A force counts only when it starts an object moving from rest.
options.D: The rubber band's change of shape happens first, and then Krish's hands stretch it.
